svg.text: Fully Disaggregated Any-to-Any Omni-Modality Serving - Stage Graph - arXiv:2602.02204
Per-stage request queues and worker pools
Stage graph nodes + edges + transfer functions
Output: hidden states, KV caches, speech codes
Thinker / Talker / LLM text encoder stages
Output: latent tensors - VAE decode to image/video
Wraps vLLM KV/EC transfer where applicable
Stage 0 Thinker (AR): video/audio/text in - reasoning + text out
Stage 1 Talker (AR): hidden states in - speech token codes out
Stage 2 Code2Wav (DiT/GAN): codes in - audio waveform out
Each stage independently scaled on separate GPU pools
Stage graph: nodes = AR or DiT engines - edges = OmniConnector + user-defined transfer functions
Orchestrator owns logical progression - each stage runs in separate process pool
Step 1: AsyncOmni receives request - build OmniEngineCoreRequest + MM data
Step 2: Orchestrator places request in Stage 0 pool (e.g. Thinker AR stage)
Step 3: StageEngineCoreClient executes AR forward - continuous batch + KV cache
Step 4: OmniConnector put() - transfer hidden states / KV to next stage via SHM or Mooncake
Step 5: Next stage (Talker AR / Code2Wav DiT) runs - stream text/audio output - repeat until done
Pipelined overlap: while Stage N executes, Stage N+1 can prepare next batch
stage-transfer functions transform query state at each graph edge
Three representative omni-modality architectures supported by stage graph
OmniConnector passes pos/neg KV caches across stage boundaries
cfg_kv_collect_func injects companion KV into DiT for parallel CFG
If you know vLLM, you know vLLM-Omni from Day 0 - same CLI with --omni flag
Fully disaggregated: each stage independently resource-allocated and horizontally scaled
vllm-project/vllm-omni - CUDA/ROCm/XPU/NPU - Ray execution - OpenAI-compatible - streaming multimodal outputs
Init path: load stage_config YAML - spawn Orchestrator - init per-stage AR/DiT engine pools - wire OmniConnectors
Step path: route request through stage graph - connector xfer - pipelined overlap - stream MM outputs
